description.zh: 结束操作的时间戳，格式为标准的UNIX_TIMESTAMP时间戳形式，您可以根据您的操作时间进行转化。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value of this parameter must be a timestamp that follows the UNIX time format.

description.zh:
执行状态，取值说明如下：
- **FAIL**：执行失败
- **CANCEL**：取消执行
- **SUCCESS**：执行成功
description.en:
The execution status of the SQL statement. Valid values:

*   **FAIL**: The execution of the SQL statement fails.
*   **CANCEL**: The execution of the SQL statement is canceled.
*   **SUCCESS**: The SQL statement is executed.
The number of the page to return.

description.zh: 每页数据量，最大值不超过100。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum values: 100.

description.zh:
SQL类型，常见SQL类型取值说明如下：

- **SELECT**：查询
- **INSERT**：插入
- **DELETE**：删除
- **CREATE_TABLE**：创建表

> 您可以在控制台页面上方操作审计->安全访问代理中查看更多SQL类型取值。
description.en:
The type of SQL statement. Valid values:

*   **SELECT**
*   **INSERT**
*   **DELETE**
*   **CREATE_TABLE**

>  You can choose Operation Audit > Secure Access Proxy in the top navigation bar of the DMS console to view more types of SQL statements.
The name of the database instance.

description.zh: 开始操作的时间戳，格式为标准的UNIX_TIMESTAMP时间戳形式，您可以根据您的操作时间进行转化。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value of this parameter must be a timestamp that follows the UNIX time format.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to query the tenant ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-proxy-sql-exec-audit-log --start-time 1636876446000 --end-time 1636962846000 --search-name test --op-user-name testNickName --sql-type SELECT --exec-state SUCCESS --page-size 100 --page-number 1 --tid 140000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise ListProxySQLExecAuditLog --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1636962846000 --PageSize 100 --SearchName test --PageNumber 1 --StartTime 1636876446000 --OpUserName testNickName --ExecState SUCCESS --SQLType SELECT --Tid 140000
